svg.font-family: 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace
svg.title: How readme-kit works
svg.desc: How readme-kit works. 14 components in 3 groups. Connections: profile.yml to readme-kit.yml (on push); readme-kit.yml to Validate (runs); Validate to Error annotations (any error); Validate to Render cards; Render cards to Fetch; Render cards to Live stats; Live stats to Fetch; Fetch to jsDelivr; Fetch to Logo hosts; Fetch to api.github.com; Render cards to Write files; Write files to Commit and push; Commit and push to assets/readme-kit/ (git push); assets/readme-kit/ to README.md (you paste snippet.md).

text.tspan: A push to profile.yml runs the action, which validates, fetches, renders and commits the cards.
OPT-IN: GITHUB: STATS, COMMIT OR BRANCH
